## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `1e80beb8df2f89513135f3a9ba6a68181e04b295`
Local-runs: none
Scope: the whole diff of #36791, `git diff ff0d1f16763bf7a2a8d57bf287b032a668704c88 1e80beb8df2f89513135f3a9ba6a68181e04b295` (25 files; the head is a merge of main at ff0d1f16 over four branch commits). Contract face (the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` declaration): `ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/sidebarFooterSlot.tsx` (new), `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/{ar,de,en,es,fr,ja,ko,pt-BR,ru,zh-Hans,zh-Hant}.ts`, `.changeset/36739-org-basics-checklist-pill.md`. Files in the diff that implement or consume it: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx`, `ui/apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx`, `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/{FirstRunChecklistPill.tsx,firstRunChecklistState.tsx,FirstRunChecklist.tsx,firstRunChecklistLogic.ts}`, the console tests `pages/settings/__tests__/{FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx,firstRunChecklistLogic.test.ts,firstRunChecklistProfile.test.ts}`, and the i18n tests `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`, `untranslated-identity-4376.test.ts`. Cited and read only: `app-shell/src/console/setupFirstPageSlot.tsx` (the precedent slot), the `package.json` of `@object-ui/{app-shell,i18n,console}` (`private`, `exports`), `.changeset/config.json` (`privatePackages`, the fixed group), `consoleSidebarRail.ts` (`collapsible`), `auth/src/AuthProvider.tsx` (`updateOrganization`), `organizations/manage/SettingsPage.tsx` (the existing rename refusal), `console/src/App.tsx` (the one `ConsolePermissionsScope` mount), AGENTS.md's changeset rule, the prior seat L2 records that judged pack-key removals.
Security-touching: no
Rule-change-verified: none

Everything below comes from reading the diff and the tree at the head. Nothing was run. The PR body, card #36739 and the maintainer's 15:21Z ruling it quotes were read for context. The head matches the PR's `head.sha`; it did not move. Check runs at the head were still in progress when read (Type Check UI, Test UI shards); Check Changeset and the PR-body guards were green.

### ① Derived judgments

**The widening declaration is right, and complete once the removed keys are counted in.**
- `@object-ui/app-shell`'s root index gains three names: the value `SidebarFooterSlotProvider` and the types `SidebarFooterSlot` and `SidebarFooterSlotPlace` (`'sidebar' | 'phoneAppHome'`). The hook `useSidebarFooterSlot` stays module-internal (only `UnifiedSidebar` imports it). The package's `exports` map has only `.` and `./styles.css`, so no other new file is addressable. No existing export or prop changes. `UnifiedSidebar`'s props are unchanged; it draws the slot in two places (footer above `AccountMenu` under `shellChrome`, and after `renderAppMenu('home')` in the phone app-home portal).
- `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true` but versioned (`privatePackages.version: true`), as the #36738 record noted for `SetupFirstPageSlotProvider`. So the export is a workspace contract rather than an npm one; declaring it `yes (widening)` is conservative and matches that precedent.
- `@object-ui/i18n` (published, `./locales` and `./locales/*`): each of the eleven shipped packs adds 11 leaf keys under `console.firstRunChecklist` (`showList`, `organizationBasics.{title,todo,name,nameRequired,prefilled,save,saved}`, `pill.{label,count,aria}`) and removes 15 (`showDoneSplit`, `confirm`, `prefilled`, `organizationName.{title,todo,action}`, `languageCountry.{title,todo,saved}`, `timezone.{title,todo,saved}`, `currency.{title,todo,saved}`). Per-pack line counts are identical (+15/−21 each). There are eleven packs, not twelve; the changeset says "all eleven", which is right. zh-Hant matches zh-Hans as generated. See N1 on the removals.
- No route, server door, spec key or error code moves. The save path uses existing doors: `updateOrganization` (better-auth) and `saveSettingsNamespace('localization')` (`PUT /api/settings/localization`).
- One meaning shifts on an unchanged key: `console.firstRunChecklist.progress` ("<done> of <total> done") now counts every drawn row, optional ones included, where it counted required rows only. The string's own words are unchanged and the changeset says so ("its progress (n/m) still counts every row"). That is console behaviour, not a pack contract.

**The slot API works for consumers.**
- It mirrors `SetupFirstPageSlot` exactly (context of `fn | null`, provider taking `value`), now with a `where` argument. A host passes a stable module-level function (the console's `sidebarFooterPill`), and the function returns an element, so the host's hooks run in its own component (`FirstRunChecklistPill`), not inside `UnifiedSidebar`'s render.
- The shell names no product feature (ADR-0060): the host decides who sees the element and when it stands aside; an absent provider draws nothing.
- See N2 on how the place union can grow.

### ② Semver level

- `patch` on `@object-ui/console`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`. This follows AGENTS.md's changeset rule: a non-protocol change, widening included, ships `patch`. Listing app-shell closes the gap N2 of the #36738 record named.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` is right: no spec, schema or authorable key moves; the slot is a runtime React context and pack keys are not something a metadata author writes.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` appear at the start of a line in both the PR body and the changeset. No `major`, no BREAKING banner owed (N1).

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Pins.** The new keys are read by the console tests (`pill.count` `0/3`, `pill.aria`, `organizationBasics.*`, zh `开始使用`), which fail on the base where the keys do not exist. `untranslated-identity-4376` allow-lists `pill.count` as a pure format string, which it is. The de-quote pins move 134 → 132 (`okSpans`) and 134/134/0 → 132/132/0: the base after #36789 is 134, and the removed `organizationName.todo` („<name>“) and `timezone.todo` („heute“) are the only two de spans that go (raw „ count in de.ts 111 → 109). The merge of main resolved the count correctly. The PR body's "133 → 131" predates the merge and is stale; the code is right.
- **Not pinned.** No app-shell test draws `SidebarFooterSlotProvider` through `UnifiedSidebar`: the two inserted lines (footer and phone app home) are unexercised by any test in the diff. Reported to L1; not a contract defect.
- **Downstream.** No source under `ui/` still reads a removed key or a removed logic export (`localizationRows`, `checklistDoneCount`, `ChecklistSettingsRow`); the remaining mentions are historical comments in `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`. The console is the only host of the new slot.
- **SQL / id materialization.** Not touched; client-only change.
- **Author.** PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (attribution `os-warren`); no separate author note owed.

### ④ Design judgment

This PR's surfaces are the `Clause-②: yes` declaration alone. They include no published schema, governed rule text or narrowing, so ④ is not required. For the record: a footer slot with a named place, rather than the shell importing the checklist, keeps the app-shell product-neutral, and one read provider above every route is what lets the pill, the Setup first page and Home's card agree.

Findings:

- **N1:** The packs remove 15 `console.firstRunChecklist` keys. The PR body and changeset disclose it ("replaces the per-setting checklist strings"), no in-repo reader remains, and seat precedent has treated removal of console-namespace pack strings as outside the narrowing arm. A consumer that indexes `en.console.firstRunChecklist.timezone.title` from `@object-ui/i18n/locales/en` would stop type-checking; naming the removed keys in the changeset would make that grep-able in the CHANGELOG.
- **N2:** `SidebarFooterSlotPlace` is a closed union passed to the host. Adding a third place later reaches a host whose function draws for any `where` it does not recognise; a one-line note on the type ("draw nothing for a place you do not know") would keep a future widening safe for hosts.
- **N3:** The changeset says the pill "keeps its icon and its count" on the folded icon rail. `FirstRunChecklistPill.tsx:80` hides the count with `group-data-[collapsible=icon]:hidden`, so only the icon stays (the count is in `aria-label`/`title`). The console runs the sidebar `offcanvas`, so the icon rail is rare there; the sentence ships in CHANGELOG.md as written.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-3ypdpe`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `0b715ebaf9572ffb6174348b1187df3902a446de`
Local-runs: none
Scope: the delta since the previous L2 (PASS at `1e80beb8df2f89513135f3a9ba6a68181e04b295`, PR comment 7117345887): `git diff 1e80beb8df2f89513135f3a9ba6a68181e04b295 0b715ebaf9572ffb6174348b1187df3902a446de`, one commit, 17 files. Contract face: `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/{ar,de,en,es,fr,ja,ko,pt-BR,ru,zh-Hans,zh-Hant}.ts` (one added key each), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/sidebarFooterSlot.tsx` (doc comment on the exported `SidebarFooterSlotPlace` only), `.changeset/36739-org-basics-checklist-pill.md`, and the PR body. Implementing and test files in the delta: `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/{FirstRunChecklist.tsx,FirstRunChecklistPill.tsx}`, `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/UnifiedSidebar.footerSlot-36739.test.tsx` (new). Cited and read only: `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` at the head (the two draw lines, `shellChrome`), `firstRunChecklistLogic.ts` (`isKeySet`, the field `set`/`offer` reading, `DISMISS_RECORD_PREFIX`), the `form.fieldRequired` and `common.close` keys in all eleven packs, `untranslated-identity-4376.test.ts`, the previous record `l2-36791.md`.
Security-touching: no
Rule-change-verified: none

Everything below comes from reading the delta and the tree at the head. Nothing was run. The head matches the PR's `head.sha`. Every check run at the head is completed: all non-skipped runs are green (Type Check UI, Test UI 1–16/16, Lint UI, Lint · ESLint, Live E2E UI, Build & E2E UI, Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Dogfood Regression Gate); the rest are skipped by path.

### ① Derived judgments

**The one new published key is well formed.**
- Each of the eleven packs adds `console.firstRunChecklist.hideHere` (en `Hide on this device`) next to `dismiss`, with the same comment line; +2 lines per pack, no other pack change. No placeholder in any pack. Every pack's string differs from en, so `untranslated-identity-4376` needs no entry (its only checklist entry is still `pill.count`). The de string has no „…“ span, so the `de-quote-pairing-3876` counts (132) are unaffected. zh-Hant (`在本機隱藏`) is the conversion of zh-Hans (`在本机隐藏`). The console reads it in exactly one place (the popover's footer button).
- The new required-field message reuses `form.fieldRequired`, and the popover X's name reuses `common.close`; both exist in all eleven packs, so the delta adds no other key.
- `SidebarFooterSlotPlace` changes only in its doc comment ("a host draws nothing for a place it does not know"); no export is added or changed. The type and value set of `@object-ui/app-shell`'s root index are as the previous record judged them.

**The changeset now lists the pack movement exactly.** Added under `console.firstRunChecklist`: `showList`, `hideHere`, `organizationBasics.{7}`, `pill.{3}` (12 leaves). Removed: `showDoneSplit`, `confirm`, `prefilled`, `organizationName.{3}`, `languageCountry.{3}`, `timezone.{3}`, `currency.{3}` (15 leaves). These match the packs at the head. This closes N1 of the previous record.

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged: `patch` on `@object-ui/console`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`. Adding one pack key is a widening and ships `patch` under AGENTS.md's changeset rule.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` each start their own line in the changeset (lines 9–10) and in the PR body (lines 6–7). No spec, schema, route or error code moves in the delta.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Pins.** The new key is read by `FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx` (`Hide on this device` as the popover's dismiss text), which fails without it. The X test fails without the fix (no `first-run-checklist-close` exists at the base), and it checks the real hide record key (`os:first-run-checklist:org_1:u_admin`, `DISMISS_RECORD_PREFIX`) stays null. The es-419 test fails without the fix: at the base Save went ahead with the rename and the offered keys and toasted 「saved」. The new `UnifiedSidebar.footerSlot-36739` test pins both draw lines: removing `footerSlot?.('sidebar')` fails the 1440 px `getByTestId`, and removing `footerSlot?.('phoneAppHome')` fails the 375 px one. Its CONTROL test covers the case where no provider is mounted.
- **Required rule.** A field is required only when `!field.set` and its draft is empty. A key locked by the environment resolves from `env` and counts as set (`isKeySet`), so a locked field is never required. A set key cleared in the form is still skipped, as before. The rule can block a Save that only renames while a key has neither a value nor an offer. That is intended: the row is done only when all four keys are set, and the changeset and PR body both say so.
- **Downstream.** No new export or reader; the console is still the only host of the slot.
- **Author.** Unchanged (`objectstack-fleet[bot]`, attribution `os-warren`).

### ④ Design judgment

Not required: the delta adds one pack key and doc text, and includes no published schema, governed rule text or narrowing.

### Previous findings

- N1 (name the removed keys in the changeset): closed.
- N2 (note on `SidebarFooterSlotPlace` for unknown places): closed.
- N3 (icon-rail sentence): closed in the changeset and the pill's header comment; see R1 for the PR body.

Findings:

- **R1 (nit, PR body only):** PR body line 23 still says "(icon and count stay on the folded icon rail)". The changeset (which ships to CHANGELOG.md) and the pill's comment now say that only the icon stays, with the count in its accessible name and tooltip. The PR body does not ship, but it is the squash-merge description.
- **R2 (minor, console behaviour, not contract):** `FirstRunChecklistPill` now derives `open` as `openOn === here` and never clears `openOn` when the location moves. A row link inside the popover calls no `onClose` (`FirstRunChecklist.tsx:206` `RowLink` and `:701`), so `openOn` keeps the page the popover was opened on. From 768 px up the pill stays mounted in the sidebar footer, so going back to that page (browser Back) opens the popover again with no press. The removed effect cleared `open` on any move. No test covers the "a row's link closes it" path. A possible fix is for row links in the popover to call `onClose`, or to reset `openOn` during render when it differs from `here`.
- **R3 (nit, style):** in ar, de, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR and ru the new `hideHere` value is single-quoted, but the keys around it in those packs are double-quoted. Lint is green; this has no runtime effect.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-3ypdpe`
Reviewed-by: `session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `c08ee22bbb9ffe57395f866b06e8586ba612c80e`
Local-runs: none
Scope: the delta since the previous L2 (PASS at `0b715ebaf9572ffb6174348b1187df3902a446de`, PR comment 7117990842): `git diff 0b715ebaf9572ffb6174348b1187df3902a446de c08ee22bbb9ffe57395f866b06e8586ba612c80e`, one commit (`c08ee22bbb`), 10 files. Contract face: `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/{ar,de,es,fr,ja,ko,pt-BR,ru}.ts` (quote style of the one `hideHere` line each) and the PR body. Implementing and test files in the delta: `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/FirstRunChecklistPill.tsx`, `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx`. Cited and read only: the `.changeset/36739-org-basics-checklist-pill.md` at the head (not in the delta), `FirstRunChecklist.tsx` at the head (`RowLink`, the `first-run-checklist-link-*` ids), the `hideHere` line in all eleven packs at the head, the previous record `l2-36791-r2.md`.
Security-touching: no
Rule-change-verified: none

Everything below comes from reading the delta and the tree at the head. Nothing was run. The head matches the PR's `head.sha` (checked before and after the review). Every check run at the head is completed (62): all non-skipped runs are green (Type Check UI, Test UI 1–16/16, Lint UI, Lint · ESLint, Live E2E UI, Build & E2E UI, Check Changeset, Dogfood Regression Gate, PR-body guards); the rest are skipped by path. One earlier PR-body guards run (job 138121290248, 00:28:29–00:28:52Z) is `cancelled`; it was superseded by the run triggered by the PR-body edit (job 138121477522, 00:28:54–00:29:08Z, success).

### ① Derived judgments

**The contract face is unchanged apart from quote style.**
- Each of the eight packs changes only its `hideHere` line, from single to double quotes; the value text is byte-for-byte the same (ar `إخفاء على هذا الجهاز`, de `Auf diesem Gerät ausblenden`, es `Ocultar en este dispositivo`, fr `Masquer sur cet appareil`, ja `このデバイスで非表示にする`, ko `이 기기에서 숨기기`, pt-BR `Ocultar neste dispositivo`, ru `Скрыть на этом устройстве`). No key is added or removed in any pack, and each of the eleven packs still has exactly one `hideHere:` line, so the key set across the eleven packs is as the previous record judged it. No value contains a `"`, so the requote needs no escaping.
- The changeset is not in the delta. `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` still each start their own line in the changeset (lines 9–10) and in the PR body (lines 6–7).

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged: `patch` on `@object-ui/console`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`. The delta is a console behaviour fix, a test and a quote-style change; no spec, schema, route, export or error code moves.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Render-time state update.** `FirstRunChecklistPill` now runs `if (openOn !== null && openOn !== here) setOpenOn(null);` during render, before `open` is derived. This is the supported "adjust state while rendering" pattern: it sets the component's own state, and it is guarded so that it cannot loop. After the set, `openOn` is `null` and the guard is false on the re-render. The guard only fires when the location has moved off the page the popover was opened on. In that render `open` is already `false` (`openOn === here` fails), so nothing opens for a frame and `onOpenChange` is not called. There is no effect and no other setter in render. Opening (`setOpen(true)` sets `openOn = here`) and closing are unchanged.
- **Pin.** The new test mounts the pill outside any `<Routes>` under `MemoryRouter initialEntries={['/apps/sales']}`, so the pill stays mounted across navigation, as it does in the sidebar footer. The test opens the popover, clicks `first-run-checklist-link-mail` (a `RowLink` `<Link>`, which calls no `onClose`), waits for the card to go, presses a `navigate(-1)` button, and then asserts that the card stays absent and the pill is present. Without the new line, `openOn` would still be `/apps/sales` after Back, so `open` would be true again and the popover would re-render its content. `queryByTestId('first-run-checklist')` would then be non-null and the test would fail. That is judged from reading the code, not from a run. The "card goes away after the link" half passes either way, through `open = openOn === here`.
- **Downstream.** No new export or reader. `BackButton` and `useNavigate` are test-only.
- **Author.** Unchanged (`objectstack-fleet[bot]`, attribution `os-warren`).

### ④ Design judgment

Not required. The delta adds no published schema, governed rule text or narrowing.

### Previous findings

- R1 (icon-rail sentence in the PR body): closed. PR body line 23 now says "on the folded icon rail only the icon stays; the count is in its accessible name and tooltip", which matches the changeset (line 16) and the pill's comment. The same line also now says that going Back does not reopen the popover.
- R2 (`openOn` not cleared on a move): closed by the guarded render-time reset, and pinned by the new test (see ③).
- R3 (`hideHere` single quotes in eight packs): closed. All eight are double-quoted and the values are unchanged.

Findings:

- **N1 (nit, test file only):** in `FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx` the new `BackButton` was placed between `renderPill` and its doc comment. `/** The sidebar's pill, as an app's sidebar draws it, under the one provider. */` now sits directly above `/** The browser's Back, ... */ function BackButton`, so `renderPill` has lost its doc comment and two JSDoc blocks are stacked. This has no runtime or contract effect. Moving `BackButton` above that comment fixes it.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-3ypdpe`
Reviewed-by: `session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj`

**VERDICT: PASS**
